subject: National Poetry Month Words and Music
overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted its First Fridays Words and Music program celebrating National Poetry Month. Former Medford Poet Laureate Terry E. Carter led readings and discussions with poets laureate C.D. Collins and Vijaya Sundaram, followed by a spoken word and jazz set performed with pianist Jonathan Fagan.

items.title: Welcome and Poet Introductions
items.summary: Terry E. Carter opened the event for National Poetry Month, recited an original poem, and introduced guest poets C.D. Collins and Vijaya Sundaram.

items.title: Discussion and Poetry Readings with Collins and Sundaram
items.summary: Collins and Sundaram recounted their personal backgrounds, discussed their roles as local poets laureate, and performed readings from their work.

items.title: Audience and Young Writers Discussion
items.summary: The panel discussed guidance for younger generations, the writing process, and the literary communities in Malden and Medford alongside additional poem readings.

items.title: Community Center Announcements
items.summary: Carter highlighted upcoming events including the legislative breakfast forum, the Hoops and Hope fundraiser, the Black Veterans Project, and a Black Maternal Health seminar.

items.title: Musical and Spoken Word Performance by The Ally Project
items.summary: Carter performed spoken word poetry accompanied by pianist Jonathan Fagan, concluding the program with selections exploring neighborhood history, gentrification, and jazz.
